items.title: 6.7.1 Enthalpy tabdeeli aur calorie content ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.7.1, printed pages 126-127.

blocks.text: Khoraak ki enthalpy of combustion, delta Hc, us ka calorie content hai jab use kilocalories fi gram mein badla jaye. Glucose ke liye, C6H12O6(s) + 6O2(g) se 6CO2(g) + 6H2O(l), delta H = -2803 kJ fi mol. Pehle fi gram delta H nikalein: glucose ka molar mass 180 g fi mol hai, to ek mole (180.0 g) jal kar 2803 kJ deta hai aur 1.0 g 2803 / 180 = 15.57 kJ fi g. Delta H (kJ fi g) = -4.184 x calorie content istemal kar ke, calorie content = -delta H / 4.184 = 15.57 / 4.184 = 3.72 kcal fi g.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Khoraak se li gai calories ko kaam, warzish aur musbat sargarmi se mutawazan karna chahiye; warna jism ki numo aur dekh-bhaal ghair-mutawazan hoti hai (energy intake banam energy expenditure).

blocks.prompt: Ethanol ki enthalpy of combustion -1368 kJ fi mol hai (molar mass 46). Us ka calorie content kcal fi g mein kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Fi gram: 1368 / 46 = 29.7 kJ fi g. Kilocalories mein: 29.7 / 4.184 = 7.1 kcal fi g, glucose se taqreeban dugna.

items: Calorie content = fi gram enthalpy of combustion taqseem 4.184 kJ fi kcal; glucose: 2803 kJ fi mol, 15.57 kJ fi g, 3.72 kcal fi g; intake expenditure ke barabar hona chahiye.
